title: How It All Started
description:
Heating shouldn’t be complicated, but for most homeowners, it is. Hidden costs, confusing quotes, and unreliable service have made something essential feel frustrating and uncertain.

That’s exactly why Heatingology was created.

We set out to do things differently. Clear, fixed pricing from the start. Skilled engineers you can trust in your home. And a service that doesn’t disappear the moment the job is done.

Today, we help homeowners across the UK stay warm, comfortable, and in control whether it’s a new boiler, a repair, or moving to smarter, more efficient heating.

Because looking after your home should feel simple.
